description: Piotr Domagalski and colleagues publish this resource through Zenodo. The principal deposit describes one-hertz Skipheia mast measurements from 2009–2016, including a second mast for 2014–2016. Native access to this high-frequency deposit is restricted. Its explicitly linked open companion provides about 180,000 ten-minute samples from 2009–2015 in text and MATLAB formats. The components share the measurement programme but have different periods and mast coverage, so equality of all observations is not asserted. Wind profiles, temperatures and nearby meteorological measurements support turbine-scale coherence and stability studies. Open access to the aggregate does not imply open access to the restricted high-frequency signals. Coverage is limited to the stated models, observations and application settings. Native metadata gives restricted access and the licence label unknown. These terms describe the deposit; software and companion-data terms are distinguished where separately established. Only descriptive metadata and file descriptors were inspected; linked data, code and document bodies were not opened.
